"''And there we have it. Excellent work, Aemon, thank you.|Aemon Gremm reporting to Dryden Vos|}} '''Aemon Gremm''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Hylobon]] who served as [[captain]] of [[Dryden Vos]]' [[Hylobon Enforcers|security forces]]. He [[Death|died]] on [[Savareen]] when [[Enfys Nest]] [[Showdown on Savareen|attacked]] his team and broke his neck. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Aemon has been with me for a while, and he remembers the old days. Back then, I would have had three times as many guards at a party like this. But that was when the five syndicates worked against each other. Now that we are allies, we cooperate. I suppose he misses the good old days, when we could operate however we wanted.|Dryden Vos, on Aemon Gremm|''[[Crimson Climb]]''}} Gremm took his responsibilities as bodyguard to Vos very seriously, and expected the same dedication from the security staff who reported to him.''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Ultimate Sticker Collection]]'' By insisting all security concerns come to him, he would take credit for his team's work and made himself essential to Crimson Dawn's operation. Like most individuals of his [[species]], he possessed a strong instinct for physical domination. {{Char-stub}} ==Appearances== *''[[Crimson Climb]]'' {{Ab|Crimson Climb (audiobook)}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} *[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation 6|''Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation'' 6]] ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Aemon Gremm|soundcat=Audio files of Aemon Gremm}} *{{SWYouTube|VNbk0UgfKHE|Solo: A Star Wars Story | "Making Solo" Featurette|sw_url=video/making-solo-solo-a-star-wars-story}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' {{1stID|Gremm}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Ultimate Sticker Collection]]'' *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Han on the Run]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide]]'' *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Topps|set=2025 Topps Chrome Star Wars|cardname=#103 - Aemon Gremm|link=https://www.ebay.com/itm/227006263715}} *{{Databank|aemon-gremm|Aemon Gremm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |cs=Aemon Gremm |es=Aemon Gremm |fr=Aemon Gremm |ja=エイモン・グレム |ka=ეიმონ გრემი |pl=Aemon Gremm |pt=Aemon Gremm |uk=Емон Ґремм }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Gremm, Aemon}} [[Category:Guards]] [[Category:Hylobon Enforcers]] [[Category:Hylobons]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
